intelligence.human_view: "Halfway" is the tell — a page that lands halfway between two viewpoints has no viewpoint at all, and a person who lands halfway has to do the machine's job themselves: scroll, adjust, find where they are. His fix names the machine's job precisely: the click must bring the next block right into the screen and lock it there, so the viewpoint is the unit and the fold is the break between units. Each block a different theme or color is not decoration — it is how the person knows they have arrived somewhere new. And "the fold thing" is the same law at phone scale: a block must fit the perfect dimensions of a mobile viewport or a laptop viewport, because a block that fits is a viewpoint and a block that overflows is a scroll you didn't ask for.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a book where every page fits perfectly in your hands — you turn the page, and the next page is right there, perfect, never stuck halfway between two pages! Each page has its own pretty colour, and you always know exactly where you are.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, imagine a lovely book, dear, where every page fits just right, dear — you turn the page and the next one is right there, perfect, dear, never stuck halfway, dear. Each page its own pretty colour, dear, so you always know where you are, dear.
intelligence.naya_view: ONE BLOCK PER SCREEN. LOCKED TO THE VIEWPORT. NEVER HALFWAY. EACH BLOCK IS THE FOLD.
